_comment: Topic queue for the ao-strength-team-daily-blog Scheduled Agent. Each run consumes the FIRST topic with status='pending' and flips it to 'published' with a publishedAt timestamp. Edit freely; the Scheduled Agent re-fetches this on every run.

topics.title: The Faith-Driven Lifter's Guide to Pre-Workout Prayer: A 5-Minute Mental Routine for Strength Training
topics.angle: 5-minute mental routine: Still / Scripture / Surrender / Set the Intention / Step Under the Bar. Faith-driven pre-workout frame for serious lifters.

topics.title: The Faith-Driven Training Split for Busy Men: A 4-Day Program That Fits a Real Life
topics.primary_keyword: faith-driven training split for busy men
topics.angle: Practical 4-day upper/lower split with a built-in Sabbath rest day. For working men with 3-4 hours of training time per week.

topics.title: What the Bible Actually Says About Physical Strength: A Lifter's Theological Primer
topics.primary_keyword: what the bible says about physical strength
topics.angle: Survey of Old and New Testament passages on the body, strength, and stewardship. Not Philippians 4:13 again — the deeper texts.

topics.title: Morning vs. Evening Training for the Faith-Driven Lifter: Choosing the Right Window
topics.angle: When to lift if you want training to serve the rest of your life, not consume it. Argues for early morning as the default for men with families.

topics.title: The 5 Compound Lifts Every Christian Man Should Know: A Strength Foundation Guide
topics.angle: Squat, deadlift, bench, overhead press, row. Why these five matter, faith-frame for hard work, beginner programming notes.

topics.title: Fueling a Strength Program on a Real Budget: The Faith-Driven Lifter's Grocery Guide
topics.primary_keyword: strength training nutrition on a budget
topics.angle: How to hit 180g+ protein under $100/week. Stewardship framing — your body and your wallet both matter.

topics.title: Training When Life Falls Apart: A Faith-Driven Guide to Staying in the Gym Through the Hard Seasons
topics.angle: Job loss, grief, divorce — the case for why showing up to the gym matters more, not less, when life is breaking. Pete-voice, honest, not preachy.

topics.title: Why What You Wear to the Gym Matters: The Case for Faith-Driven Training Apparel
topics.angle: Identity-formation argument for intentional training apparel. Soft pitch for AO without being a sales page. Releases 1 day before drop.

topics.title: Alpha and Omega: What Revelation 22:13 Means for the Man Under the Bar
topics.primary_keyword: alpha and omega meaning for christians
topics.angle: Theological deep-dive on the Alpha and Omega title of Christ, what it means for a lifter's identity, and why it's the foundation of the AO brand. Releases day of launch.

topics.title: Your First 30 Days of Strength Training: A Faith-Driven Lifter's Survival Guide
topics.angle: Practical onboarding for the absolute beginner. What to do, what to skip, what to expect physically and spiritually in the first month.

topics.title: The Faith-Driven Lifter's Guide to the Deadlift: Form, Programming, and Mental Frame
topics.angle: Cue-by-cue deadlift breakdown plus the mental/spiritual frame for the lift that humbles every lifter who takes it seriously.

topics.title: The Sabbath Rest for Lifters: Why a Real Day Off Makes You Stronger
topics.angle: Theology + physiology of the seventh-day rest. Argues for one true off day per week — not active recovery, full Sabbath.

topics.title: Protein Targets for the Faith-Driven Athlete: How Much You Actually Need
topics.angle: The evidence-backed protein target (~0.8g/lb bodyweight) and why the bro-science of 2g/lb wastes money. Stewardship angle.

topics.title: Sleep Is the Foundation: A Faith-Driven Athlete's Guide to Recovery Through Rest
topics.angle: Why sleep beats every supplement on the market. The 7-step pre-sleep routine for serious lifters.

topics.title: Training With Your Son: A Faith-Driven Father's Guide to Building Strength Together
topics.angle: Multi-generational angle. How to introduce a 12+ y/o son to lifting without crushing him; age-appropriate progressions; the discipleship frame.

topics.title: Building a Faith-Driven Garage Gym Under $1500: The Essential Equipment List
topics.angle: Specific equipment list with prices. Why a garage gym beats a commercial gym for the faith-driven man who wants privacy + family proximity.

topics.title: The 10-Minute Mobility Routine for Faith-Driven Lifters Over 30
topics.angle: Daily mobility sequence targeting hips, T-spine, and shoulders. Frame: stewardship of the body God gave you for the long run.

topics.title: Training While Fasting: A Faith-Driven Lifter's Guide to Strength Work During Lent or Personal Fasts
topics.angle: Practical adjustments for training during religious or personal fasts. Honest about what works and what doesn't.

topics.title: The Faith-Driven Lifter's Guide to Squat Programming: A 12-Week Block for Real Progress
topics.angle: Concrete 12-week squat block with weekly RPE/load prescriptions. For intermediate lifters who've stalled.

topics.title: The Faith-Driven Comeback: Returning to the Bar After Injury Without Losing Your Mind
topics.angle: Mental and spiritual frame for the long return. Practical re-loading protocol. When patience is obedience, not weakness.

topics.title: Fasted Cardio for the Faith-Driven Lifter: What the Research Actually Says
topics.angle: Myth-busting on fasted cardio. When it helps, when it doesn't, and why the morning prayer + walk combo is undervalued.

topics.title: Finding a Faith-Driven Training Partner: How Iron Sharpens Iron in the Gym
topics.angle: Proverbs 27:17 framing. What to look for in a training partner, how to find one in your church, and why solo training has a ceiling.

topics.title: Cutting Without Losing Strength: The Faith-Driven Lifter's Guide to a Disciplined Fat-Loss Phase
topics.angle: 12-week cut protocol that preserves muscle and strength. Stewardship framing without crash-diet nonsense.

topics.title: The 5-Minute Morning Prayer Routine for Faith-Driven Athletes
topics.angle: Companion piece to the pre-workout prayer guide. The morning routine that sets the whole day, not just the workout.

topics.title: The Only 4 Supplements Worth the Money for Faith-Driven Lifters
topics.angle: Creatine, protein, vitamin D, fish oil. Why the rest is wasted money and where to spend it instead. Stewardship angle.

topics.title: Training When You Don't Feel Like It: The Faith-Driven Discipline of Showing Up
topics.angle: The motivation-vs-discipline argument from a Christian frame. Practical tactics for the days the body says no.

topics.title: The Faith-Driven Lifter's Guide to the Bench Press: Form, Programming, and the Plateau
topics.angle: Bench press deep-dive: setup, cues, plateau-breaking programming. The lift with the worst ego-injury ratio in lifting.

topics.title: Training as the Cheapest Anti-Anxiety Medication: A Faith-Driven Case
topics.angle: Honest, careful look at how heavy compound lifting reduces anxiety, with a faith-driven theology of suffering and the body. Defers to professional help when warranted.

topics.title: What to Wear Under the Bar: The Faith-Driven Lifter's Apparel Guide
topics.angle: Practical breakdown of training apparel — shirts, shorts, shoes, belt, sleeves. AO product mention is the natural fit, not a forced sale.

topics.title: Summer Training for the Faith-Driven Lifter: Heat, Hydration, and Holding the Line
topics.angle: Hot-weather training adjustments. Hydration math. Why summer is the season most lifters slip — and how to not.

topics.title: The Annual Review for Faith-Driven Lifters: How to Plan a Year of Training That Honors God
topics.angle: Year-long planning framework — strength blocks, hypertrophy blocks, deloads, and Sabbath rhythms. Closes the 30-day series with a long-horizon view.
